DECLARE

 al_button Number; 
 pl_id ParamList;
 pl_name VARCHAR2(10) := 'tempdata';
BEGIN 
 al_id := Find_Alert('Choice_alert'); 
 Set_Alert_Property(al_id, alert_message_text, 'Do you want to see "Alert" messages ?' ); 
 al_button := Show_Alert( al_id ); 
 if al_button = ALERT_BUTTON1 then
 pl_id := get_parameter_list(pl_name);
 IF NOT ID_NULL(pl_id) THEN
 destroy_parameter_list(pl_id);
 END IF;
 pl_id := create_parameter_list(pl_name);
 IF ID_NULL(pl_id) THEN
 message('Error creating parameter list '||pl_name);
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;
 run_other_form(lower('UTQALERT'),'X',pl_id);
 end if; 

end;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-CHECKBOX-CHANGED
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
if :pb_sel_flag = 'Y' then -- Checkbox is marked
 if :control_block.pb_id != 'NEW' then
 :pb_sel_flag := 'N' ;
 show_error('11151') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 end if ;
 if :control_block.drive_id1 is null then
 /*---- Check for overlapping timings. -----*/
 if :control_block.drive_id2 is not null then
 if (:drive_piggy.schedule_start_time between
 :control_block.sch_start2 and :control_block.sch_end2) or
 (:drive_piggy.schedule_end_time between
 :control_block.sch_start2 and :control_block.sch_end2) then
 :pb_sel_flag := 'N' ;
 show_error('11269') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 end if ;
 end if ;
 :control_block.spon_id1 := :drive_piggy.sp_id_hide;
 :control_block.drive_id1 := :drive_piggy.drive_id ;
 :control_block.spon_name1 := :drive_piggy.sp_name ;
 :control_block.sch_start1 := :drive_piggy.schedule_start_time ;
 :control_block.sch_end1 := :drive_piggy.schedule_end_time ;
 elsif :control_block.drive_id2 is null then
 /*---- Check for overlapping timings. -----*/
 if :control_block.drive_id1 is not null then
 if (:drive_piggy.schedule_start_time between
 :control_block.sch_start1 and :control_block.sch_end1) or
 (:drive_piggy.schedule_end_time between
 :control_block.sch_start1 and :control_block.sch_end1) then
 :pb_sel_flag := 'N' ;
 show_error('11269') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 end if ;
 end if ;
 :control_block.spon_id2 := :drive_piggy.sp_id_hide;
 :control_block.drive_id2 := :drive_piggy.drive_id ;
 :control_block.spon_name2 := :drive_piggy.sp_name ;
 :control_block.sch_start2 := :drive_piggy.schedule_start_time ;
 :control_block.sch_end2 := :drive_piggy.schedule_end_time ;
 else
 :pb_sel_flag := 'N' ;
 show_error('11152') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 end if ;
else -- Checkbox is unmarked
 if :control_block.drive_id1 = :drive_piggy.drive_id then
 :control_block.drive_id1 := null ;
 :control_block.spon_name1 := null ;
 :control_block.sch_start1 := null ;
 :control_block.sch_end1 := null ;
 :control_block.spon_id1 := null;
 elsif :control_block.drive_id2 = :drive_piggy.drive_id then
 :control_block.drive_id2 := null ;
 :control_block.spon_name2 := null ;
 :control_block.sch_start1 := null ;
 :control_block.sch_end1 := null ;
 :control_block.spon_id2 := null;
 end if ;
end if ;
end ;

Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 v_address_id varchar2(10) ;
 v_mapsco varchar2(1000) ;
 v_local_time date;
 v_local_time1 date;
begin

begin
 select Initcap(name),sponsor_id into :drive_piggy.sp_name, :drive_piggy.sp_id_hide
 from sponsors
 where sponsor_id = (select sponsor_id from drive_sponsors
 where drive_id = :drive_piggy.drive_id
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and rownum = 1)
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id ;
 exception
 when no_data_found then null ;
 when others then
 handle_error ; 
 check_package_failure ;
end ;
begin
 select description into :drive_piggy.type_desc
 from valid_master_codes
 where code_type = 'DRVTY'
 and code = :drive_piggy.drive_type ;
 
 exception
 when no_data_found then null ;
 when others then
 handle_error ;
 check_package_failure ;
end ;
begin
 select initcap(substr(first_name||' '||last_name,1,40))
 into :drive_piggy.recruiter_name
 from employees
 where staff_no = :drive_piggy.recruiter_id 
 and emp_class = 'RECRT' 
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id ;
 exception
 when no_data_found then null ;
 when others then
 handle_error ; 
 check_package_failure ;
end ;

begin
 select nvl(number_reqd,0) into :drive_piggy.staff
 from drive_estimated_resources
 where drive_id = :drive_piggy.drive_id
 and resource_code = 'STAFF'
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id ;
 exception
 when others then 
 handle_error ;
 check_package_failure ;
end ;

 if is_timezone_enabled then
 
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,:drive_piggy.schedule_start_time,v_local_time);
 
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,:drive_piggy.schedule_end_time,v_local_time1);
 
 :drive_piggy.drive_time := to_char(v_local_time,'HH24:MI')||'-'||to_char(v_local_time1,'HH24:MI'); -- to_date(to_char(v_local_time, 'mm/ddHH24:MI'), 'HH24:MI'); 
 
 else
 :drive_piggy.drive_time := to_char(:drive_piggy.schedule_start_time,'HH24:MI')||'-'||to_char(:drive_piggy.schedule_end_time,'HH24:MI');
 end if;

--:drive_piggy.drive_time := to_char(:drive_piggy.schedule_start_time,'HH24:MI')||'-'||to_char(:drive_piggy.schedule_end_time,'HH24:MI');

if (:drive_piggy.schedule_end_time - :drive_piggy.schedule_start_time)*24 <= :control_block.pb_dur_param
and :projected_show <= :control_block.pb_show_param
then
 :drive_piggy.suitable_flag := 'Yes' ;
else
 :drive_piggy.suitable_flag := 'No' ;
end if ;

 
begin
 select Initcap(location_name),address_id into :drive_piggy.loc_name ,v_address_id
 from locations
 where location_id = :drive_piggy.location_id 
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;
 -- and rownum=1 ;
 
 if v_address_id is not null then
 begin
 select mapsco into v_mapsco
 from addresses
 where address_id = v_address_id 
 and rownum=1;
 if v_mapsco is not null then
 :drive_piggy.loc_name := 'MAPSCO'||':'||' '||v_mapsco||' '||'LOCATION'||':'||' '||:drive_piggy.loc_name ;
 end if ;
 exception
 when no_data_found then null ;
 when others then 
 handle_error ;
 check_package_failure ;
 end ;
 end if ;
exception
 when no_data_found then null ;
 when others then 
 handle_error ; 
 check_package_failure ;
end ;
if :control_block.pb_id != 'NEW' then
 if :control_block.drive_id1 is null then
 :control_block.drive_id1 := :drive_piggy.drive_id ;
 :control_block.spon_name1 := :drive_piggy.sp_name ;
 :control_block.sch_start1 := :drive_piggy.schedule_start_time ;
 :control_block.sch_end1 := :drive_piggy.schedule_end_time ;
 :control_block.spon_id1 := :drive_piggy.sp_id_hide;
 elsif :control_block.drive_id2 is null then
 :control_block.drive_id2 := :drive_piggy.drive_id ;
 :control_block.spon_name2 := :drive_piggy.sp_name ;
 :control_block.sch_start2 := :drive_piggy.schedule_start_time ;
 :control_block.sch_end2 := :drive_piggy.schedule_end_time ;
 :control_block.spon_id2 := :drive_piggy.sp_id_hide;

 end if;
end if ;
end ;

RecordGroup.Name: DRIVE_DATE_RG
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
select 
 distinct
 drive_date,
 to_char(drive_date,'MM-DD-RR') drive_date_char 
 from drives,drive_groups
where drives.drive_id = drive_groups.drive_id 
 and drives.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and drive_date > :local_date
 and drive_groups.chapter_id = drives.chapter_id
 and drive_groups.drive_group_type = 'PIGGY'

RecordGroup.Name: DRIVES_RG
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
select 
 drives.drive_id,
 drive_date,
 name 
 from drives,drive_sponsors,
 sponsors 
 where drive_date = :control_block.s_drive_date
 and drive_type in ('I','C')
 and drives.status in ('CNFRM','HOLD')
 and drives.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and drive_sponsors.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and drive_sponsors.sponsor_id = 
 (
 select 
 sponsor_id
 from drive_sponsors 
 where drive_id = drives.drive_id
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id 
 and rownum = 1
 )
 and drive_sponsors.drive_id = drives.drive_id
 and sponsors.sponsor_id = drive_sponsors.sponsor_id
 and sponsors.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id

RecordGroup.Name: PIGGY_RG
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
select a.drive_group_id,
 b.drive_id drive_id1,
 a.drive_id drive_id2 
 from drive_groups a,
 drive_groups b 
 where a.drive_group_id = b.drive_group_id 
 and a.chapter_id=:global.chapter_id 
 and b.chapter_id = a.chapter_id 
 and a.drive_group_id in 
 (
 select distinct 
 drive_group_id
 from drive_groups
 where drive_id in 
 (
 select drive_id 
 from drives
 where drive_date = :control_block.s_drive_date
 and drive_type in ('I','C')
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id)
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id)
 and a.drive_id != b.drive_id 
 and b.drive_id= 
 (
 select drive_id 
 from drive_groups 
 where drive_group_id = a.drive_group_id
 and chapter_id=:global.chapter_id
 and rownum = 1
 )
